target.title: Skip duplicate header newline validation
target.description: WSGI servers already reject header values containing newlines, so checking every value here is duplicate work on a hot path.

summary: Remove newline validation from _str_header_value in werkzeug datastructures headers to improve hot path performance.

suspects.title: Removal of newline check may permit header injection via Response or external clients
suspects.problem: Removing the newline validation here means Werkzeug no longer validates header values before they are used, potentially exposing applications to HTTP response splitting or header injection if downstream WSGI servers or other callers (like test clients or direct header manipulation) do not strictly validate newlines or handle them differently.
